title: Surcharge and Health & Education Cess
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: Health and Education Cess is levied at a mandatory flat rate of 4% on the aggregate amount of income tax plus surcharge. It applies across both the Old and New Tax Regimes. Surcharge is an additional tax levied on high-income taxpayers whose total taxable income exceeds specific limits: 10% surcharge for income between ₹50 lakh and ₹1 crore; 15% surcharge for income between ₹1 crore and ₹2 crore; 25% surcharge for income between ₹2 crore and ₹5 crore; and 37% surcharge (Old Regime) or capped at 25% (New Regime) for income exceeding ₹5 crore.
